title: Harness Focus: - Start Small: Begin a Task, Even If You Can’t Finish It
description: To harness focus: - Start small: Begin a task, even if you can’t finish it right away. - Use checkpoints: Pause at natural stopping points to keep motivation. - Let it linger: Use the tension of an unfinished task to stay motivated. Example: Write the first sentence of an email or presentation to make it easier to continue later.
